answer: A vertex of per-task receipts records who did what, and the atlas of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. What survives to the vine is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
